webhooks.label: Couriers tell the shop when a parcel moves (webhooks)
webhooks.help: Off as shipped. When on, Steadfast and Pathao may call the shop's address /api/courier/steadfast/webhook or /api/courier/pathao/webhook the moment a parcel moves; each call needs the token or secret typed into Keys & connections, is kept once, and moves the parcel and its order like a status read. The hourly read stays on as the fallback. The size is the largest call the shop reads, in KB.
